# RenShinKan Dojo

> RenShinKan Dojo is an Aikido dojo in Baan Waen, Hang Dong, Chiang Mai, Thailand. The site provides class times, first-visit guidance, instructor profiles, dojo history, community updates, and contact details in English, Thai, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://renshinkandojo.org/)
- [Aikido](https://renshinkandojo.org/aikido)
- [Instructors](https://renshinkandojo.org/instructors)
- [Classes and weekly schedule](https://renshinkandojo.org/classes)
- [Workshops](https://renshinkandojo.org/workshops)
- [Dojo journal](https://renshinkandojo.org/newsletter)
- [Community](https://renshinkandojo.org/community)
- [Contact and first visit](https://renshinkandojo.org/contact)

## Key facts

- Location: 155 Soi 6, Suan Luang Village, Baan Waen, Hang Dong, Chiang Mai 50230, Thailand.
- Weekly practice: Tuesday and Thursday 17:30–19:00; Saturday and Sunday 09:00–10:30.
- Each 90-minute class begins with 60 minutes open to all levels and finishes with 30 minutes of advanced and weapons-focused practice.
- Beginners, children, adults, experienced aikidoka, and visitors are welcome.

For current announcements and event details, prefer the linked pages above.
